environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALBv2. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule group 'app-input-validation' with a RegexPatternSet match condition on query string values matching pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+(?:all\s+)?select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|(?:--|#|\/\*).*$|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d)` with action BLOCK, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default action. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress policy (tasks can reach internet), and CloudWatch Logs captures all ALB access logs. The custom rule group has a rate-based rule of 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP as a separate lower-priority rule.

config.waf_rule_priority_2: custom-rule-group:app-input-validation with regex block on SQL meta-characters in query string values
